title: MLConf 2026 travel - expenses & vendor contacts (scratchpad)
body:
Quick scratchpad for MLConf 2026 travel - booking, expense reminders, vendor contacts, and reimbursements. Mostly TODOs and notes to self.

Trip basics:
- Event: MLConf 2026 (San Francisco)
- Dates on badge: 2026-03-22 - 2026-03-25 (will travel 3/21-3/26)
- Booking owner: me (Derek) - coordinate with travel@redwood.com if needed

Flights:
- Booked: SFO <> LAX (example) - flight ref: TKX123 (placeholder until travel team confirms)
- Prefer nonstop if under $450. If >$450 consider 1-stop to save $80+ and check total travel time.
- Reminder: add boarding pass + email confirmation to Ramp/expense within 30 days of return.

Hotel:
- Plan to book near Moscone Center - check conference partner rate first (usually has code).
- Vendor contact (conference hotel block):
  - Hotel: Moscone Plaza Hotel (placeholder)
  - Block contact: reservations@mosconeplaza.com / +1-415-555-0123
  - Attn: Group Sales (ask about Redwoods block code: REDWOOD-MLCONF)
- If booking outside the block, save receipt and note reason (block was full / price difference)

Ground travel / rideshares:
- Use rideshare for late arrivals. Save receipts/screenshots.
- Consider renting car only if doing multi-site meetings. Use company car program (contact: travel@redwood.com).

Vendors & contacts (for admin):
- Corporate travel (internal): travel@redwood.com - general booking, changes, corporate rate questions
- Expense platform: Ramp (expenses@ramp.com support) - receipts upload, card charges
- Finance approver for eng-ml: Jordan Kim (jordan.kim@redwood.com)
- Event ops contact (MLConf): events@mlconf.org - exhibitor logistics + shipping
- AV/vendor for demo booth: BrightAV - contact: maria@brightav.io / +1-650-444-2233

Expense categories / codes (notes for submission):
- Expense code: ENG-ML-MLCONF (use for all travel/booth related expenses)
- Meals: per-diem allowed - check Confluence travel policy (linked) for limits; flag any client entertaining separately
- Lodging: itemize nightly rate + taxes; include hotel folio if possible
- Transportation: flights / rideshare / rental - attach receipts
- Booth expenses: shipping, AV, furniture rental - tag as BOOTH-MLCONF in comments when submitting

Reimbursement checklist (submit via Ramp):
- Scan/photograph all receipts (jpg/pdf) - name files like "MLConf-hotel-2026-03-22.jpg"
- Include conference badge or proof of attendance for booth-related spends if asked
- Fill expense form with: date, merchant, amount, expense code (ENG-ML-MLCONF), project note (MLConf 2026 - demo), approver Jordan Kim
- Submit within 30 days of final expense date to avoid delays
- If missing receipt, add a note and mark as "missing receipt" with explanation; finance may require manager approval

Budget estimates (rough) - update after bookings:
- Flights: $400-650
- Hotel (4 nights): $220/night -> ~$880 + tax
- Meals: $75/day x 6 days = $450 (estimate)
- Booth / AV / shipping: TBD (ask ops for preliminary quote)
- Total estimate: $2k-3k (w/o booth shipping & AV)

To-dos (Derek):
- [ ] Confirm flight booking with travel@redwood.com by 2026-02-16
- [ ] Lock hotel within conference block if rate < $300/night (target by 2026-02-18)
- [ ] Request booth/AV quote from ops (email BrightAV + events@mlconf.org) - due 2026-02-20
- [ ] Add expense code ENG-ML-MLCONF to Ramp submission notes (remind finance if not present)
- [ ] Compile receipts folder in Google Drive: /users/derek-huang/expenses/mlconf-2026/ (will create after trip)

Notes to self / misc:
- If booking personal upgrade, pay personally and label as "personal upgrade" on expense report (finance policy)
- Keep copies of shipping invoices for demo materials - they can be large and need pre-approval for reimbursement
- Check passport/ID one week before (even for domestic, have backup ID photo)

Possible issues / questions to ask travel ops:
- Can we get early check-in for people arriving the day before? (some hotels charge)
- Is there a vendor-approved AV partner with discounted rates?
- How to handle expedited shipping claims if booth materials arrive late?

End of scratchpad - will tidy into formal travel doc once bookings are finalized.

Notes timestamp: quick updates 2026-02-10 -> 2026-02-14
